thesis: AVADHSUGAR exhibits extreme short-term overheating with a 157% rally over 126 sessions, pushing momentum to unsustainable levels. While recent quarterly sales grew 8.7%, annual net profit fell 35%, highlighting fundamental weakness beneath the rally. Entering at current levels carries severe downside risk from potential mean reversion and profit-taking.
risks: Sharp mean reversion after parabolic +157% run-up
Weak underlying earnings with annual profit down 35%
Policy and regulatory changes in the sugar sector
